title: Stationary quasi-periodic pulsations in 20-second cadence TESS flares
rationale: Chosen because the BAII extraction reports a 20-s TESS flare universe and source QPP/non-selection classifications generated before F3A. The source identity and scientific role are frozen now; F3A.2 must verify the event-level catalogue artifact, identifiers, timing fields and archive-product mapping before any materialization. Failure blocks materialization rather than triggering an automatic source substitution.

title: Properties of Flare Quasiperiodic Pulsations Based on a New TESS Flare Catalog
rationale: Catalogue-scale TESS QPP classification is directly relevant for external-label context, but BAII records an access limitation and a different 2-min/FCN classification regime. It may annotate cross-matched events if deterministic provenance can be established, but it does not define the primary F3A cohort.

title: Scalable, Advanced Machine Learning Based Approaches for Stellar Flare Identification: Application to TESS Short-cadence Data and Analysis of a New Flare Catalog
rationale: Provides a large 2-min TESS flare-identification catalogue and upstream selection comparator, but BAII does not report QPP reference labels. Rebuilding or switching the primary flare universe would conflate upstream flare detection with the primary QPP robustness question.

title: Stellar flare morphology with TESS across the main sequence
rationale: Provides an alternative 2-min TESS flare catalogue with LSTM detection and vetting, but no QPP reference labels in BAII. It informs positioning and upstream-selection limitations rather than primary cohort membership.
